'''Tik trees''' were a type of tree that may have been native to [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] or a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. The palace gardens on Hapes had Tik trees.
